vulnerability_title: Tax fee revenue may be lost due to Uniswap V4 trading

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: _executeBuy mints DUTCH to the hook, transfers it to the PoolManager and calls settle, so the PoolManager has to be able to receive DUTCH. This is the design that, according to the finding, stops the PoolManager from being blacklisted.
patterns_found: minted DUTCH routed through the PoolManager during a buy
issues: The blacklist is in the DUTCH token contract and the untaxed trading happens in other Uniswap V4 pools; this file shows only the buy flow that causes the problem.
`accountDelta` is a PoolManager term and does not occur in this file.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: tax bypass because the PoolManager cannot be blacklisted
